ItemID: NA; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Familiar, melodic songs sound appealing alongside my recent country and vocal-focused listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Appetite For Destruction Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Hard rock feels too aggressive for my current preference for relaxing music and polished vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Abbey Road; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodies appeal, but I would choose a more vocal-focused album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavier, darker sound does not fit what I want to hear right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Master of Puppets; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Intense metal is far from the soothing classical music and melodic singing I have recently chosen.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Expressive singing and emotional ballads fit my interest in strong vocal performances.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles 1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Tuneful songs are appealing, but this compilation is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Kid A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Experimental electronic textures are less appealing right now than clear melodies and prominent singing.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Different Kind of Truth; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Guitar-driven hard rock does not match my current listening mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: If this is Adele's 21, the vocals appeal, but I would try 25 first.
